questions.explain: The chapter defines regression (stable plan replaced by worse plan), parameter sensitivity/parameter sniffing (plan compiled for one parameter distribution performs poorly on another), and optimizer-version regression (optimizer behavior changes across upgrades).
options: Blocking, deadlocking, and livelocking
Regression, parameter sensitivity (parameter sniffing), and optimizer-version regression
CPU regression, memory regression, and I/O regression
Plan cache misses, compile locks, and recompiles
questions.q: What three categories of plan instability must the autonomous system distinguish?

questions.explain: A CV above 1.5 or volatility ratio above 3.0 flags a query as a plan-investigation candidate; the detection query runs typically every five minutes for OLTP systems.
options: Coefficient of variation above 1.5 or volatility ratio (max/avg elapsed) above 3.0
More than 10 distinct plan_handles per query hash
Any execution longer than 1 second
Average logical reads above 1000
questions.q: What are the chapter's primary instability signals and thresholds for flagging a query for automated plan investigation?

questions.explain: The state machine is candidate → accepted → pinned: captured in a clean window, promoted after surviving validation runs, forced only in response to a detected regression; failing re-validation demotes it.
options: Captured -> Forced -> Monitored
Candidate -> Accepted -> Pinned
Draft -> Tested -> Retired
Proposed -> Vetted -> Archived
questions.q: What is the plan baseline promotion state machine, and what does it prevent?

questions.explain: Validation requires a real statistical test: at least 10% mean improvement, p < 0.05 across both Welch's t-test and Mann-Whitney U, across at least 30 validation executions — an equivalent plan is rejected since any plan change carries risk.
options: An eyeballed 5% difference in one test run
Mean improvement of 5% over 5 executions
Improvement visible in a single execution plan
At least 10% mean improvement, statistically significant at p < 0.05 across both Welch's t-test and Mann-Whitney U, over at least 30 validation executions
questions.q: What criteria must a candidate plan meet to be promoted in the shadow execution validation framework?

questions.explain: The chapter enforces a cooldown (no further forcing for that query for ~1 hour) and escalates to human review if the same query regresses again within 24 hours of a prior force — evidence the cause is something the policy doesn't understand.
options: Automatically force the next-best plan immediately
Enforce a cooldown (~1 hour) and escalate to human review if the same query regresses again within 24 hours of a prior force
Drop the query from Query Store
Unforce all plans for the database
questions.q: How does the chapter prevent rollback oscillation when a forced plan itself starts regressing?
